description: Turkish Navy Tracker held on the Kocaeli Üniversitesi Arslanbey campus, wearing the code TCB-887. Construction number 162C. spottingmode carries it with instructional-airframe status at the university. Last updated 19 July 2025.
Turkish Navy Agusta-Bell 204 at the Arslanbey campus, at 40.71098 30.02474. Construction number 3235. spottingmode status preserved last updated 5 July 2021.

Starfighter at the Arslanbey campus, listed by spottingmode only in the location description for the site and not linked to a plane record. The International F-104 Society lists F-104G 8168 at Arslanbey University Kocaeli in a green scheme; that identity is credible but single-sourced, so tail_number is deliberately blank and the candidate serial is stated here.
